title: 2021 Monthly Planner Printables / Floral
author: Digital to Art
description:
Digital (PDF) Interior pages provide thirteen pages with dated 2021 monthly calendars.  The digital file allows you to duplicate pages, mix with other pages, add a cover, and publish!  In addition, there are NINE covers/dividers to use as you wish, add more pages, or add inspirational quotes between the months.  The PDF files can be uploaded and edited in PowerPoint or just printed out to add to your own binders or printable collection.
KDP Sellers: Why have your books like everyone else’s? If you have PowerPoint, the source file is included so you can edit the font and other graphics easily (you cannot sell or share this source file for any reason). This makes this product more valuable to you as a publisher. It allows you to make it unique instead of the same files everyone else is using.  NOTE: This is NOT a “ready to upload” full book because it is best to make the book as you see fit instead of just uploading the same file as everyone else!  Consider mixing and matching with other printables in my shop or others. Make it Unique!!
There are TWO PPT – one for each size (A4 and US Ltr)
But, if you don’t have Power Point, I included PDFs as well. The PDFs are in TWO sizes (A4 and 8.5″x11″).
If you want to customize, the PDF files can be uploaded and edited in Sedja, or other free PDF editing tools.
Includes:
– THIRTEEN pages of 2021 monthly plannerin 2 sizes (2 PDF files). The PDF files are high-resolution (300 DPI) allowing for clear printing.
– Source (.pptx) file in A4 and US Letter
**NOTE: Bleed IS required as graphics go to the edge
You can
– Use for Print on Demand Products
– Use for personal digital planners/journals
– Use as personal printable
Notes:
These are files to be used to create journals or notebooks on Amazon KDP (Kindle Direct Publishing), LuLu, or other books or to add to your favorite digital planner (Good Notes) for personal use. You can not SELL the templates or digital files in any way. Highly recommend customizing the templates to stand out on KDP or other POD websites.
